name: after
text: The technology before this one in its menu slot: the menu shows it only after that research. train.unlocked.

name: age
text: The age of a technology (0 Dark, 1 Feudal, 2 Castle, 3 Imperial; build.AGE for the units and buildings). The menu shows it from that age on.

name: age_times
text: The train or research time in each age (Return of Rome docks: [Stone, Tool, Bronze, Iron]), in place of "time". train.seconds.

name: aoe2_name
text: The AoE2 name of a unit with no name of the scenario parser (the record of Record Game writes its AoE2 type): TRADE_CART_EMPTY, WAR_CHARIOT_FOCUS_FIRE, RATHA_RANGED, ELITE_RATHA_RANGED. record.queued.

name: arrows
text: An upgrade of one building (one_building): the arrows that the building shoots more, also with no garrison. garrison.arrows_command.

name: attack_aura
text: An upgrade of one building (one_building): the own military units within "range" tiles of the building attack "rate" times as fast, {"rate", "range"}. train.haste.

name: build_rate
text: A technology that makes the builders of the player work faster: the factor of the work per second (Antiquity Architecture). build.rise.

name: breach
text: true: after this technology the villagers attack enemy walls, gates and towers (Siegecraft of Antiquity Mode). gather.breach.

name: civ
text: The civilization of a unique technology: only its castle researches it (civs.MISSING of the others).

name: converts
text: A technology that converts more: ["buildings" (enemy buildings, as Redemption), "monks" (enemy priests and monks, as Atonement)]. monk.CONVERTS.

name: costs
text: A technology that changes the cost of a group of items: a list of [a rule what of civs.has, a resource or null for all, the factor], as the rules of civs.COSTS. civs.cost.

name: doctrine
text: A switch of the Recruitment Doctrines of its building (Macedonians): no queue and no cost, the next doctrine of the civ key "doctrines". train.DOCTRINES, train.switch.

name: economy
text: true: an economic technology that the AI bot researches when its age and building offer it (Loom, Double-Bit Axe, Wheelbarrow). game/bot.py research.

name: effect
text: The change of the AoE2 combat values of a technology (train.effect: a dict, or a list of changes in turn; "bonus_times" multiplies a bonus). train.TECHS and train.EACH compute it; civs.MORE changes it.

name: faster
text: A unit that trains faster from an age: [age, its train time from that age] (the eagle scout and eagle warrior). train.seconds.

name: glow
text: Treason: the enemy Kings glow for so many AoE2 seconds. regicide.treason.

name: housing_factor
text: A technology that multiplies the population room of a building (Urbanization: {"HOUSE": 2}). train.limit.

name: lead
text: A technology that makes the shots of the units of its test lead a moving target, as with Ballistics (Arquebus: gunpowder units). train.lead_command, AoePlugin.lead.

name: line
text: The short name of a line at its first technology (Blacksmith, or an economy line: lumber, mining, mill, town center); the line follows the "after" chain. replay.SMITH and replay.ECO_LINES, the tiers of the live replay.

name: on_research
text: The functions ("module.function") that run at the research of a technology, with (g, entry): its special effect in its own module, not an if block of train.research.

name: rest
text: A technology that changes the rest of a priest after a conversion: the factor of the AoE2 seconds of the rest (Fanaticism: 0.5). monk.convert.

name: shares
text: A technology that shares the sight of the player with its allies (Antiquity Mode: Writing): before its research the allies do not see for the player, also with "Shared Exploration" on. fog.shares.

name: population
text: A technology that changes the population of its units: [the units (as "walk": a building, a group, a class, a name or a list), the factor]. train.weight.

name: reach
text: A technology that adds conversion range and line of sight in tiles to the monks (Afterlife of Antiquity Mode: priests +3). monk.near, gather.seen.

name: start_age
text: The name of the age before the first age (the line of the first age only): Dark Age, Stone Age. build.AGE_NAMES.

name: team
text: true: the allies of the player get the technology too, with its keys "work" and "costs" (Kasbah, Butalmapu). train.researched.

name: toggle
text: A switch of the player with no queue and no cost: the name of a flag of the Gather (off at the start). A click switches it, the item says on or off. train.queue, train.show.

name: towers
text: Guard Tower, Keep, Thalassocracy: {building: the building of its values}, in the research order (file order). build.line.

name: walk
text: A technology that makes units walk faster: [the unit, a class of combat.STATS in lower case, a group of civs.GROUPS, a building (the units it trains, Drill #4254) or a list of these (Herbalism #4254), the walk speed factor]. train.speed.

name: walk_add
text: A technology that adds walk speed in tiles per second: [the unit, a class of combat.STATS in lower case or a group of civs.GROUPS, the added speed]. train.speed.

name: walls
text: A wall technology (Fortified Wall): {wall: the new wall}. The new and the complete own walls get the new design (build.design).

name: heal_rate
text: A factor of the hit points that a monk heals per second (Medicine of Antiquity Mode: 2). monk.heal.

name: convert_rate
text: A factor of the conversion speed of a monk (Astrology of Antiquity Mode: 1.3). monk.convert.

name: sight
text: Tiles of line of sight for the units of its tests: {"if": [tests], "add": n} (Engineering of Antiquity Mode: siege units and ships +2). train.sight_more: the attack sight and gather.seen.

name: more_arrows
text: A unique technology (Castle Age, AoE2 DE wiki): {building: arrows} that the own buildings of that name shoot more, with or without a garrison. train.more_arrows, garrison.arrows.

name: pack_time
text: A factor of the AoE2 seconds to pack or unpack a trebuchet (Kataparuto: 0.25). trebuchet.pack_time.

name: regen
text: A technology that regenerates hit points of a group of units: [a group of civs.GROUPS, the hit points per AoE2 minute]. civs.regen.

name: building_taken
text: The factor of the bonus damage that a building of the player takes after the technology: {building: factor} (Citadels: a castle 0.75). build.taken.

name: less
text: A technology that cuts the damage that its units take from attackers of some classes: [the units (as "walk"), {attacker class: n}]; the most of the classes of the attacker counts (Royal Heirs). train.hits.

name: ignore_armor
text: A technology whose melee units ignore the armor of the target (a negative armor still counts): the units, as "walk" (Wootz Steel). train.hits.

name: unit_aura
text: A technology whose units of the group "from" heal the allied units of "group" within "range" tiles by "rate" hit points per AoE2 minute: the largest rate counts (Bimaristan). regen.units.

name: rage
text: A technology whose units attack more as they lose hit points: [the units (as "walk"), the attack for each 10 % of lost hit points] (Hamask). train.hits.

name: reflect
text: A technology whose units give a part of the damage of each hit that is no projectile back to the attacker: [the units (as "walk"), the part] (Lamellar Armor). train.hits.

name: fee
text: The trading fee of the player in percent after the technology (Guilds 15, Grand Trunk Road 10). market.FEES.

name: gold_rate
text: The factor of the trade and relic gold of the player after the technology (Grand Trunk Road 1.1). trade.gold_rate.

name: spawn
text: Free units at the research: {"unit", "at": building, "count" per building, "most" buildings}; the upgraded unit of its line (First Crusade). train.research.

name: keep_housing
text: A technology whose own buildings of these names keep their population room when they fall after the research (Nomads: ["HOUSE"]). ruins.fall, train.limit.

name: per_own
text: A technology that costs more for each own unit: [the kinds (a unit name starts with one), the cost per unit] (Flemish Revolution: villagers). train.per_enemy.

name: rival_years
text: A technology that adds years to the relic and wonder victory timers of each enemy (Atheism: 100). wonder.later.

name: rival_relic_gold
text: The factor of the relic gold of each enemy after the technology (Atheism: 0.5). monk.relic_tick.

name: work
text: A technology that makes one building work faster: [the building, the factor of its train and research rate] (Perfusion: ["BARRACKS", 2]). A unit group can join the form later. train.work, train.seconds.

name: throw
text: A charged ranged attack of a melee unit after the technology: {"if": [tests], "reload": AoE2 s to charge one axe, "gap": s between two throws, "range": tiles, "shots": the most charged axes} (Gothikon). train.fire_commands, aoe throw.

name: trickle
text: A technology that adds income for each working unit of a kind: [who ("farm", "wood" or "military"), {resource: per AoE2 second}] (Tuntian). feitoria.tick.

name: train_group
text: A technology that makes a unit group train faster: [the units, as "walk", the factor of the train rate] (Steppe Husbandry: the scout line 2). train.group_rate, train.seconds.

name: near
text: Values that depend on the own units near a unit: {"if": [tests], "range": tiles, "per": units for one step, "most": steps, "add": {field: n per step}, "part": {field: part of the field per step}} (Shield Wall, Coiled Serpent Array). near.py, train.stats.
